vibe_rationale: Authentic independent music core and a 15-venue Valley takeover, but conference-led and trade-facing, so it is narrower and a little more commercial than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Music workers and emerging-music fans, mostly adults, with weak general wellness adjacency; the clearest angle is artist wellbeing, which a musician recovery strand could meet. QMusic already takes non-endemic partners such as Hutchinsons Builders, so the route is credible.
